summary_en: On October 28, 2026, the company executed a block purchase of 3,385,000 shares at 3,545 yen per share via ToSTNeT-3, totaling 11.999 billion yen, representing 13.4% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock via Off-Hours Matching System (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On October 28, 2026, Chuo Spring's board of directors executed a block purchase of 3,385,000 treasury shares at a fixed price of 3,545 yen per share via the Tokyo Stock Exchange's ToSTNeT-3 off-hours matching system on October 29, 2026 at 8:45 a.m. The total acquisition cost was 11,999,825,000 yen, representing 13.4% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock.

This execution was conducted under the authorization granted at the same board meeting, which approved a buyback program with an upper limit of 4,500,000 shares (17.8% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) and a maximum purchase price of 15 billion yen over the period from October 29, 2026 to October 28, 2027. The company plans to conduct additional open market purchases for the remaining authorized amount after this block acquisition is completed.
